text.text_excerpt: I did not get a chance to stay at the hotel but would recommend for out of towners or here for business friends. The rooftop bar was fantastic though. Really great happy hour specials and killer views of the city. Recommend!!

Was so happy to be back in NOLA and even happier to be back at NOPSI. Have stayed here countless times in my travels to New Orleans since it opened in 2017. By far the best hotel in the city. It's conveniently tucked away in the CBD, close enough to be in walking distance to all the regular spots but far enough away to keep you out of the fray and noise. Excellent staff, gorgeous lobby and large comfortable rooms tastefully decorated with quality furniture. Excellent lobby bar and restaurant and super chill roof top open air bar and pool area with great view of the city and super dome. I loved this hotel. Arrived on a Saturday afternoon to discover that my original hotel had mistakenly cancelled reservation and we had no place to stay (another review will be posted about that for sure!). A kind person in ear shot suggested the Nopsi. Wow - am I happy we went there. Spotless. Lovely service and decor, nice towels, good gym and a great roof top bar overall it was a luxury experience without the ultra luxury price tag A few small kinks that reflect that the venue is new. For example, restaurant is slow to serve (but food was fresh and made to order) and staffing overall seemed light considering the size of the hotel.
